title: Container With Most Water
description:
Imagine a vertical line of height height[i] rising from each array position i. Choose two lines to hold water between them. The water's depth is limited by the shorter line, and its width is the difference between their indices. Return the greatest possible area.

Testing every pair is unnecessary. As two endpoints move toward each other, width only shrinks, so moving the taller endpoint cannot improve the limiting height. This gives a linear-time way to search all promising pairs.

Example 1:

Input: height = [1,8,6,2,5,4,8,3,7]
Output: 49

Example 2:

Input: height = [1,1]
Output: 1

Example 3:

Input: height = [4,3,2,1,4]
Output: 16

Constraints:

  • 2 <= height.length <= 100,000
  • 0 <= height[i] <= 10,000

exampleTestCases.explanation: Lines at indices 1 and 8 give width 7 and depth 7.
The outer lines give depth 4 across width 4.
